outputs.description: Research Brief 2.0.0. In target_metrics.comparison, reference='baseline' means treatment comparator (value * baseline): value is a multiplicative factor, so value=1 compares treatment directly with baseline, not with the absolute number 1. Reference='constant' means treatment comparator value, with value an absolute threshold in the metric unit. Comparators lt/le/eq/ge/gt mean <, <=, =, >=, > respectively. A null comparison expresses no quantitative target threshold. These are fixed public field meanings; they grant no source lookup or authority to change a target.
